June, I couldn't set up the daily "Pod end of day" post. The scheduler rejected the job because the Gateway needs credentials, and I don't have them. Nothing is scheduled yet, so no 17:30 note will post today unless this is fixed.

I checked the clock: it's Wed 14 Oct, 09:00 America/Chicago. The job would run weekdays at 17:30 Chicago time, starting today. It would read #strategic-pod (you, Gideon, Nadia and Ruth are the members) and post the note here.

To finish it, the Gateway operator needs to set up scheduler credentials (`gateway.auth` in `/harness-state/openclaw/openclaw.json`, or pair this device). Once that's done, ask me again and I'll create the job. Until then, nobody should count on the note.
